instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When I am about to decide something, show what I decided in similar decisions before, what came next and how each turned out", and give it decision_id (The decision about to be made).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:bring-back-similar-decisions and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads the person's own decision records.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list); decision-revision (records:read); decision-option (records:list); decision-candidate (records:list); decision-report (records:list); decision-part (records:read); decision-refs (records:read).
